name: Checklists for Jira
tagline: Required items, templates that apply themselves, board progress, JQL fields and workflow gates. Free for 10 users, then US$0.60 per user.
highlights: Multiple named checklists per issue with headings, assignees, due dates and four statuses; a required item cannot be skipped, enforced in the engine not the UI.
Project admins define templates by issue type and every new issue gets its checklist, idempotently. Save any live checklist as a template in one click.
Visible on boards and in JQL
A Checklist progress field for cards, eight JQL aliases such as checklistDone and checklistPercent, and three workflow validators to gate transitions.
